name: Deformation Field Integration for Telepresence
definition: Synthesizes a new view image by marching a ray and accumulating radiance, where the query ray is bent by the deformation field before sending to NeRF.
summary: Deformation Field Integration for Telepresence renders animatable 3D head avatars by warping sample positions via learnable and skeletal deformation fields within the FastNeRF ray marching process.
